standard_prerequisites.name: Vanishing in a localisation as annihilation by a power
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used at the start of the counted proof (lines 4635-4637)
standard_prerequisites.use: Rewrites injectivity of the map into the product of localisations as a condition on elements killed by powers of the f_i.

standard_prerequisites.name: Induction on the sum of the exponents
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the general annihilation data to the case where all exponents are one.

core_obligations: Rewrite the injectivity of the map into the product of localisations as the statement that an element killed by powers of all the f_i is zero (proof lines 4635-4637).

One direction is immediate from that rewriting (proof line 4638); for the converse assume the product map injective and argue by induction on the sum of the exponents, the base case being all exponents equal to one (proof lines 4639-4644).
In the induction step replace m by f_i m when some exponent exceeds one, apply the induction hypothesis, and reduce to the base case (proof lines 4645-4647).
proof_roadmap: Translate injectivity into a statement about elements annihilated by powers of the f_i (proof lines 4634-4638).
Run an induction on the total exponent, reducing to the case of single powers (proof lines 4639-4648).
difficulty_reason: For elements f_1, ..., f_n of a ring R and an R-module M, the lemma states that the map into the product of the localisations M_{f_i} is injective exactly when the map multiplying m by the tuple (f_1 m, ..., f_n m) is injective (statement lines 4621-4632). The proof does not compute with fractions: it rewrites the first condition as the statement that an element killed by powers of all the f_i vanishes, gets one direction immediately, and proves the converse by induction on the sum of the exponents, reducing in the induction step to a smaller total exponent by multiplying the element by one of the f_i (proof lines 4634-4648). The induction on the total exponent is the substance, and the author writes each step out. H2.
